_about: The OSAPS store's own fabrics, from the owner's product list (osapafabric.pdf, 18 Oct 2026). Prices are per yard as given. Stock is a placeholder: set the real figure in the vendor hub. Material and width were not in the list, so they are left empty for the vendor to fill in.
